2: "Commercial" means any type of building other than residential. "Residential" means any building or unit of a building intended for occupancy as a dwelling but shall not include a hotel or motel

(b) The owner, or his agent, of a building undergoing new construction or repair or renovation who is entitled to an exemption as specified in subparagraph (a) (2), (3), or (4) of this section shall obtain the exemption by applying at the office of the building inspector for the City of Molena.
